description: Caelestia-inspired Windows 11 desktop shell with a customizable dock, dynamic themes, glass effects and desktop tools.
notes: Scoop extracts the Inno Setup payload only; it does not run the vendor setup tasks that create Start Menu/Desktop shortcuts, HKCU startup values, or PATH entries.

Winlestia replaces the Windows taskbar while it is running. Optional startup and terminal integrations can create current-user scheduled-task, registry, and PATH entries when enabled from the application.
The profile and settings are stored outside Scoop in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Panneaux and are not removed by Scoop uninstall.
